reasons: Cited Section 3.19 imposes the exclusivity on SFJ (counterparty) in favour of PB, which the rule expressly treats as acceptable and not a deviation; no redline is appropriate.

No requirements-purchase, sole-supplier, or 'shall not procure from any third party' obligation on our party appears in the cited paragraphs, and the deterministic check confirms no such obligation remains.

Section 2.4.2 is mutual and merely channels third-party engagements through Exhibit C/JDC approval; it does not compel purchases from the counterparty or bar other suppliers, so the rationale's reading is sound.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed; the finding is retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
Rationale appropriately flags Section 7.5.5 as belonging to a different rule, avoiding double-flagging the same commercial term.
